purpose: Isolate E1 registration/callback visibility in a fresh temporary cwd and file, without D1 instrumentation or repo discovery. Synchronous markers distinguish callback execution from file pass; never replace required named native PASS.
negative_requires: Gate C named native PASS; create/run at most one negative afterward
original_E1_execution_requires: Both native reference controls pass; at most one unchanged original execution if static comparison insufficient
capture: Direct native CLI with separate raw stdout/stderr redirects. Four synchronous fd2 markers plus owned temporary marker-file receipts establish reachability/callback/write boundaries without wrapping test or changing assertions. No preload/custom reporter/filter reset.
stop_policy: Named positive result absent -> immediate stop; only static command/environment/reference analysis thereafter. No retries/source correction.

marker_interpretation.B1_BEFORE_REGISTRATION: Execution reached before direct test() call, not native registration ack
marker_interpretation.B1_REGISTRATION_CALL_RETURNED: Direct call returned without synchronous throw, not native registration ack
marker_interpretation.B1_CALLBACK_STARTED: Callback entry independently observed if marker emitted
marker_interpretation.B1_ASSERTION_COMPLETED: Code after unchanged explicit assertion reached if marker emitted

mandatory_named_result: Native Subtest e1-native-positive and corresponding individual ok record, root0. File-level PASS/markers/summary alone insufficient.
